success_semantics: Accepted means both repository-local controls and independent Assurance establish the declared static boundary
refusal_semantics: A constitutional violation returns a bounded rejection and does not become an infrastructure skip
failure_semantics: Malformed policy, parse failure or unavailable required tooling fails the gate
cancellation_semantics: Cancellation stops evaluation and cannot produce acceptance
indeterminate_semantics: Missing or contradictory evidence cannot produce acceptance
recovery_semantics: Rerun from the unchanged tracked inventory; no partial policy result is canonical
compatibility_or_reset_policy: The unused internal module identity resets to celestia.research/celestia without forwarding compatibility; product paths, protocol, persistence and runtime behaviour remain unchanged
